modal_policy: Runtime modal inventory. Routeable modal criteria are defined in docs/07-routing.md and enforced by scripts/qa/check-navigation-registry.js.

order.ticket.route.routing_reason: Trading ticket is a transaction flow that benefits from refresh recovery, deep links, and external task entry.

discover.layout.route.routing_reason: Current route-backed configuration layer; consider demoting if deep link or recovery is not required.

non_routeable_modals.auth.countryPicker: Country picker sheet for phone flows.
non_routeable_modals.global.bottomSheet: Shared BottomSheet host and presets for all mobile bottom-sheet interactions.
non_routeable_modals.quick.actionSheet: Quick actions content rendered through shared BottomSheet actionMenu preset.
non_routeable_modals.funding.paymentMethodSheet: Funding payment or payout method selection sheet.
non_routeable_modals.portfolio.closePositionConfirm: Close position confirmation through shared ConfirmActionSheet.

hard_rules: Non-routeable modal entries must not define routePath.
Ordinary confirmation, success, failure, toast, tips, delete confirmation, and picker sheets must not be independent routes.
Only routeable modals may point to paths in routeRegistry.
